reviews.title: Not working how it should
reviews.text: I don’t know whether this is a broken app or the design is flawed. Creating an invoice is easy enough however, when it comes to sending, there’s no save and send despite the customer email added to the contact. I haven’t save as draft, mark it as sent and then share. This is totally counterintuitive and am sure this is not how it’s meant to be. It’s a shame because I’ve used other Zoho apps and they seem to be good. I will look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Confusing and not easy to use
reviews.text: This app is confusing and not easy to use. The initial set up of clients etc is okay but how are you meant to send the actual invoice? It’s taken more time and effort than the standard one we have switched from

reviews.title: Deletes Invoices
reviews.text: Unfortunately, my invoices are now only accessible through the app and I cannot access them on my Mac or through the website. They are only accessible through the phone app. I’ve used this service for a while, but beware, your data might end up being deleted, leaving you in a nightmare position if you don’t have a backup.

reviews.title: Not User Friendly Initially
reviews.text: I finally decided to use the ZOHO Invoice app to create an invoice because a customer and friend had recommended the app.  I was hoping to open the app and learn in realtime to send an invoice for a job just completed, but find it difficult to accomplish a quick first invoice.  It’s possible after using and studying I’ll have a different viewpoint, but since the pop-up to rate the app came up at this time, I’ve rated it, as I CURRENTLY see it.

reviews.title: Quit “Revamping” an app that worked well
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Zoho Invoice for almost 2 years. Both the previous large updated completely changed how easy it was to use. When I first used it, the graphs made seeing profits, spending, receiving simple and clear. Changed to the pie graph was a slight irritation, but still manageable. This most recent “revamp” to a “cleaner and easier” design, made things twice as difficult. The menus that were easily identifiable are now hidden behind buttons that are completely unnecessary. It’s no longer “clean and sleek” and it’s over designed and cluttered. The old saying “if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it” should have come into play here. 
Underwhelmed and a bit frustrated.
